entities.summary: Hadrut is an Armenian town in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, Azerbaijan. Until 2020 it was controlled by the breakaway Republic of Artsakh. The town had an ethnic Armenian-majority population, prior to the 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh war.
